name: Guardian Council
notes: This boss fight used to be named the "Guardian Trinity".
related_quests: Blood and Sand: Help a Dwemer researcher recover her notes on a Dwemer artifact.
Pledge: Volenfell: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Volenfell.
Volenfell Pledge: Explore Volenfell and return Undaunted. (disabled since Patch 2.6.4)
summary: The Guardian Council refers to three Dwarven Centurions in The Eye's Chamber section of Volenfell: Together they make up the final boss fight of the dungeon. They have a chance to drop the Antiquity lead for the Dwarven Leather Saddle Seat and Volenfell Etching Tools. In Veteran mode, they will drop a Tremorscale set helmet.
